A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found the best N:M sparsity scheme from pre-trained dense ResNet50 and achieved the highest accuracy with the smallest model size (i.e. 76.7/5.0M).
we propose the first algorithm to search for layer-wise fine-grain N:M sparse schemes to achieve higher accuracy with equivalent complexity constraints than the uniform N:M scheme.
we have developed a new technique -- DominoSearch to find layer-wise fine-grain N:M sparsity from dense DNNs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
layer-wise fine-graining of N:M sparse DNNs is a promising research direction for future hardware-algorithm research.
layer-wise N:M sparsity is an effective approach for neural pruning and is a promising direction for hardware-algorithm co-optimization.
